content: प्रयाणम् .²1 Setting out, starting, departure. .²2 A march, journey; मार्गं तावच्छृणु कथयतस्त्वत्प्रयाणानुरूपम् <ls>Me. 13</ls>; <ls>Mb. 7. 166. 1</ls>. .²3 Progress, advance. .²4 The march (of an enemy), an attack, invasion, expedition; कामं पुरः शुक्रमिव प्रयाणे <ls>Ku. 3. 43</ls>; <ls>R. 6. 33</ls>; प्रयाणपटहध्वनिं प्रथयति स्म ताराध्वनि <ls>Rāmāyaṇachampū.</ls> .²5 Beginning, commencement. .²6 Death, departure (from the world); प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः <ls>Bg. 7. 30</ls>. .²7 The back of a horse; <ls>Mb. 3. 71. 16</ls>. .²8 The hinder part of any animal.
